newsitem.title: UK: Enron gets go-ahead to boost Sutton Bridge output.
newsitem.headline: Enron gets go-ahead to boost Sutton Bridge output.

text.p: Enron Europe Ltd has received Section 36 planning approval from the UK's Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) to increase the capacity of Sutton Bridge Power Station in Lincolnshire, the company announced on Tuesday.
The capacity of the plant, currently under construction, will be raised to 790 MegaWatts (MW) from 700 MW.
Work started in April on the 300 million stg combined cycle gas turbine plant, which is due for completion in mid-1999.

The plant, which will have two gas turbines and one steam turbine, will be supplied with natural gas from the National Transmission System, operated by Transco, a division of BG plc, by a new 2.2 km pipeline.
And the plant will be connected to the National Grid at the NGC substation at Walpole Marsh, 3.5 km south east of the power station, by a new section of 400 kv overhead line.
